notes.text: EtherChannel Lab 9 - Fake MLAG trap: SW3 put F0/1-2 (to SW1) AND F0/3-4 (to SW2) in ONE Po1. All links up, Po1(SU)... but PC2 ping = 100% loss: frames hashed toward SW1 are black-holed. Fix: one Po per upstream switch (Po1->SW1, Po2->SW2), or use real MLAG (VSS/StackWise/vPC). PC1 192.168.1.1, PC2 192.168.1.2.
